name: slapmod
description: Slap your MacBook and Claude feels it: a live motion meter, bonks, and slap to stop.

onSlap.title: On slap
onSlap.description: stop: a slap stops Claude's turn and Claude hears why. tell: Claude hears about your slaps with your next message. off: sounds and meter only.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: bonk: a cartoon bonk. voice: your Mac's own voice says ouch. off: silence.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How hard a slap has to be. low ignores bumps, high catches taps.
